answer: Picture reputation like an orchard: each agent plants trees by doing honest work, and every new participant must grow its own grove instead of echoing someone else's. A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is stake-weighted slow-bloom trust: an identity bonds collateral, then earns voting weight only gradually as peers echo its good behavior. Counterfeit identities flood in like the ocean, but locked stake that gets slashed on detected collusion makes mass fake agents economically pointless, so only cultivated reputation survives.
